title: Counting Successor-Closed Subsets of Functional Digraphs
summary: A functional digraph is a directed graph where each vertex has an out-degree of at most 1. We study the number of successor-closed subsets of a functional digraph, that is, subsets from which no edge leaves. We show that functional digraphs have a simple recursive formula for their corresponding generating function. Using this formula, we determine, among all functional digraphs with a fixed number of vertices and edges, the one that maximizes and the one that minimizes the number of successor-closed subsets of every size simultaneously.
